flags.why: Thân hữu means close friends, rather than relatives or loved ones generally, as defined in [VDict](https://vdict.com/th%C3%A2n%20h%E1%BB%AFu%2C3%2C0%2C0.html).
The cross-eyed sense is primarily Southern usage and needs a regional label; [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%C3%A9) marks this sense as dialectal.
In the example, nhân khẩu denotes individual household members, not their number, a distinction reflected in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nh%C3%A2n_kh%E1%BA%A9u).
flags.fix: person counted as a member of a household or population; population

flags.why: The entry omits the common housing sense of a house with a garden, which is included in [Rung.vn](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Nh%C3%A0_v%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dn).
The common food-related meaning referring to dog or dog meat is missing, although it is recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%E1%BA%A7y).

Phát dục refers to development or reaching puberty, whereas being in heat is động dục; the developmental meanings are recorded in [Vtudien](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-ph%C3%A1t%20d%E1%BB%A5c).
flags.fix: to reach puberty; to become sexually mature
